shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright && which chromium || which google-chrome || true && npx playwright install chromium'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-browser-deps && cd /tmp/pulse-browser-deps && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpcre2-8-0 libffi8 libmount1 libselinux1 libsystemd0 libwayland-server0 libcap2 libgcrypt20 liblzma5 libzstd1 liblz4-1 libgpg-error0 && for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser-deps/root; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-browser-deps && apt-get download libxrender1 libxi6 && for package in libxrender*.deb libxi*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser-deps/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-browser-deps && apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 && for package in fontconfig*.deb fonts-dejavu*.deb libfontconfig*.deb libfreetype*.deb libpng*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" /tmp/pulse-browser-deps/root; done'

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-fonts && cat > /tmp/pulse-fonts/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/pulse-browser-deps/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/pulse-fonts/cache</cachedir><config></config></fontconfig>
EOF
